title: Close the Copper strobe else-branch outside the debugger guard
reason: 6100b17 custom.cpp puts the closing brace of an else branch inside #ifdef DEBUGGER; without the debugger the unit does not compile. Upstream always defines DEBUGGER.
test: GEN01; native build of the profile

title: Guard debug_dma and cpu_thread_tid uses that 6100b17 added unguarded
reason: New upstream code uses debug_dma (drawing.cpp, two sites) and cpu_thread_tid (newcpu.cpp) outside the #ifdef DEBUGGER / WITH_THREADED_CPU that declare them.
test: GEN01; native build of the profile

title: Exclude the CIA-B Velvet keyboard MCU hooks and the desktop aspect flag
reason: 6100b17 adds keymcu_do() calls to the CIA-B register writes (A3000 Velvet prototype, host keyboard MCU excluded from the profile) and resets gfx_keep_aspect_seen, declared in the desktop configuration region excluded by patch 0042.
test: GEN01; native build of the profile

title: Beam state accessor (BEAM) reads the variables 6100b17 still has
reason: 6100b17 removed linear_display_vpos, linear_vpos_visible, current_linear_vpos_visible, display_last_hsync/vsync and rga_pipe.conflictaddr, made linear_vpos_vsync debugger-only and split the DMAL shifter in Agnus/Paula halves. The accessor keeps its 89-word layout: removed words read as 0 and are ignored on load, the two DMAL words carry the Agnus and Paula shifters. The state is therefore NOT complete for the new beam/vblank detection (proposed task UPD state-beam).
test: native build; state suites expected to diverge (see report)

title: Scheduler state accessors for the reworked secondary scheduler and the file-local blitter handler
reason: 6100b17 replaced event2idx by firstvent2idx/event2next/event2total with a growing event2max, and the blitter no longer owns secondary slot 0 (blitter_handler is static, scheduled with event2_newevent_xx). p6_events_get/set carry firstvent2idx+1 in the old idx word and re-derive event2max/event2total from the restored table; p6_blitter_handler names the handler for the state id table. event2max itself is not carried (a restored image may differ in slot placement from the original: proposed task UPD state-scheduler).
test: native build; state suites expected to diverge (see report)

title: Copper state accessor (COPR) carries the Copper fields 6100b17 still has
reason: 6100b17 reimplemented the Copper (copper_states, state, state_prev, strobe_next, strobeip, strobetype, strobe_cycles are gone; prev_strobe and the load/skip/validmove latches are new). The 15-word layout is kept: gone words read as 0 and are ignored on load. The state is NOT complete for the new Copper (proposed task UPD state-copper).
test: native build; state suites expected to diverge (see report)

title: Frame geometry accessor (GEOM) drops the two vidbuffer fields 6100b17 removed
reason: struct vidbuffer lost inwidth2/inheight2; the 26-word GEOM layout is kept with those two words as 0, ignored on load.
test: native build; state suites expected to diverge (see report)

title: Keep get_statefile_version outside the excluded legacy .uss region
reason: 6100b17 restore_cpu asks get_statefile_version() (6.0.0-6.0.3 state fix-up); patch 0055 excludes the .uss reader that defined it. The profile defines it next to the variable and it stays 0.

title: Call the counter-restart hook before 6100b17's early set_cycles of the reset path
reason: Upstream commit 066f6bc0 ('Always clear pending events and set cycle counter when emulation restarts') starts the counter over (and clears the events) at the top of the reset branch of m68k_go, before the place where patch 0073 calls p6_counter_restart_hook. The bridge then saw the counter already at zero: the board clock (p6_rtc) found cycles going backwards and latched a fault ('the clock service failed during the unit') in the first unit after p6_reset. Found by REF01 (a500-vsync-reset3-pal).

title: softfloat.cpp includes the header under the name upstream gave it
reason: 6100b17 renames softfloat/SOFTFLOAT-MACROS.H to softfloat-macros.h. Patches 0021 (softfloat.cpp) and 0143 (fpp_softfloat.cpp, softfloat_decimal.cpp) wrote the old upper-case name so that -Werror=nonportable-include-path passes on a case-insensitive host. 0143 is dropped (its includes are upstream's again); this patch undoes the part of 0021. Found by tests.host.test_audio_math.
